mapper.select: SELECT CACHE_ID, USER_ID, MERCHANT, CATEGORY, HIT_COUNT FROM MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CACHE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND MERCHANT = #{merchant} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CACHE ( CACHE_ID, USER_ID, MERCHANT, CATEGORY, HIT_COUNT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( nextval('SEQ_MERCHANT_CACHE'), #{userId}, #{merchant}, #{category}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, MERCHANT) DO UPDATE SET CATEGORY = EXCLUDED.CATEGORY, HIT_COUNT = MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CACHE.HIT_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
